title: 第290章上梁采购
slug: 临时加彩礼转头另娶绝美女知青
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

既然去纺织厂了，陈卫东便打算给曹斌也送点野猪肉过去。

关系是需要走动的，这一来二去的，就熟悉了。

二妹和二姐夫转正还需要曹斌拍板决定呢，陈卫东多给点好处，往后二姐和二姐夫转正也容易许多。

这几天工人伙食需要的量，再加上送人的量，加起来顶多几十斤肉就够了。

剩下的还有二百斤肉呢，陈卫东让老娘抹点儿盐巴子腌制一些，再给大伯，三叔家各送十斤，剩下的明天他就拿去彪哥那边卖了。

晚上在陈卫东的建议下，一家人不煮饭了，而是吃烤肉。

猪肉切成片，抹点儿腌料，直接在铁板上烤。

烤出来的野猪肉，蘸着陈卫东调的烤肉料，再包上生菜和蒜瓣，说不出的香。

因为晚上吃烤肉，家里的人口又多，这一顿饭竟然消耗了快十斤肉。

不过女人们没吃太多，毕竟她们的胃口有限。

肉能消耗这么多，主要是陈卫东还有陈大河，外加徐阳三个大男人都很能吃。

尤其是陈卫东，他一个人就能炫掉两斤肉。

当然，他们能这样吃，主要还是家里肉多。

要是家里的肉不多，哪里能这么造？

别说他们农村人了，就算是城里人，一个月可能也就几斤肉的额度，家家都是省着吃肉的。

一家人吃饱喝足后，陈大河心满意足地摸了摸自己的肚子，随后看着儿子道：“卫东，明天上午咱家就得上梁了，明早你去一趟供销社，买点上梁需要的东西回来。”

上梁需要用到鞭炮，花生糖果，都需要去供销社采购。

现在家里有自行车，去一趟倒是不麻烦。

上午上梁，安排十点左右。

陈卫东早上早点出发，肯定能在十点前赶回家。

陈卫东冲陈大河点头：“行，爹，我知道了。”

徐阳知道，自己家的房子也是陈卫东帮着盖的。

既然一起上梁，上梁需要的东西徐阳觉得肯定不能让陈卫东替他花钱，这份花销得他自己承担才行。

于是徐阳便冲陈卫东道：“东哥，上梁购置东西的费用，你把我的那一份也算上，回头多少钱，从我的钱里面扣。”

陈卫东知道徐阳这小子是不想占他的便宜，但是陈卫东却不高兴道：“阳子，这能花几个钱啊？

Page (1/3)

Now that he has gone to the textile factory, Chen Weidong plans to send some wild boar meat to Cao Bin.

Relationships require movement. Once you go back and forth, you will become familiar with it.

Cao Bin still needs to decide whether the second sister and the second brother-in-law will become regular employees. If Chen Weidong gives more benefits, it will be much easier for the second sister and the second brother-in-law to become regular employees in the future.

The amount of food the workers need these days, plus the amount given away, adds up to at most a few dozen kilograms of meat.

There are still two hundred kilograms of meat left. Chen Weidong asked my mother to put some salt on it to marinate some, and then give ten kilograms to each of the uncle and third uncle's families. The rest will be sold to Brother Biao tomorrow.

In the evening, at Chen Weidong's suggestion, the family stopped cooking and had barbecue instead.

Cut the pork into slices, apply some marinade, and grill directly on the iron plate.

The roasted wild boar meat is dipped in the barbecue sauce prepared by Chen Weidong, and then wrapped with lettuce and garlic cloves. It is indescribably fragrant.

Because we had barbecue in the evening and there were many people in the family, this meal actually consumed nearly ten kilograms of meat.

But the women didn't eat much, after all, their appetites were limited.

Meat can consume so much, mainly because Chen Weidong and Chen Dahe, plus Xu Yang, are three big men who can eat it.

Especially Chen Weidong, he can show off two pounds of meat alone.

Of course, the main reason why they can eat like this is because there is a lot of meat at home.

If you don’t have much meat at home, how can you make it like this?

Not to mention the rural people, even the urban people may only have a few kilograms of meat per month, and every family saves on eating meat.

After the family had eaten and drank, Chen Dahe touched his belly with satisfaction, then looked at his son and said: "Weidong, our family will have to go to the beam tomorrow morning. You go to the supply and marketing cooperative tomorrow morning and buy some things needed for the beam."

Firecrackers and peanut candies are needed for the beam, and they need to be purchased from the supply and marketing cooperative.

Now that I have a bicycle at home, it’s no trouble to go there.

Liang Liang in the morning, arranged around ten o'clock.

Chen Weidong sets out early in the morning and will definitely be able to get home before ten o'clock.

Chen Weidong nodded to Chen Dahe: "Okay, Dad, I understand."

Xu Yang knew that Chen Weidong helped build his own house.

Since they were going to the beam together, Xu Yang felt that he couldn't let Chen Weidong spend money for him on the things he needed to go up the beam. He had to bear the expense himself.

So Xu Yang said to Chen Weidong: "Brother Dong, please include my share of the cost of purchasing things in Shangliang. How much money you get back will be deducted from my money."

Chen Weidong knew that Xu Yang didn't want to take advantage of him, but Chen Weidong said unhappily: "Yangzi, how much can this cost?
